# Murf AI

> > Murf AI is an AI-powered platform for generating realistic voiceovers, cloning voices, and building conversational voice agents with 200+ multilingual voices.

Murf AI provides enterprise-grade text-to-speech, voice cloning, and voice agent solutions with seamless integrations into popular content creation tools. The platform supports 35+ languages and accents, enabling creators and enterprises to produce professional audio content at scale.

## Key Topics

- Text-to-Speech (TTS)
- AI Voice Generation
- Voice Cloning
- Voice Agents
- Conversational AI
- Murf Falcon (Voice API)
- Multilingual Support
- Audio Conversion
- Voiceover Studio
- Content Creation
- Enterprise Solutions
- API Integration
- Voice Customization
- Dubbing

## Core Products

- [Murf AI Homepage](https://murf.ai): Murf AI homepage showcasing AI voice generation, text-to-speech, and voice agent products
- [Text to Speech](https://murf.ai/text-to-speech): Free text-to-speech online with 200+ realistic AI voices in 35 languages and accents
- [Voice Cloning](https://murf.ai/voice-cloning): Create realistic voice clones professionally in 20+ languages for personalized audio content
- [Voice Changer](https://murf.ai/voice-changer): Convert recorded voices to professional AI voices with realistic voice transformation
- [Murf Falcon](https://murf.ai/falcon): Fastest and most efficient TTS API for real-time voice agents in 35+ languages with low-latency performance

## Enterprise & Professional Tools

- [Murf AI for Enterprise](https://murf.ai/enterprise): Enterprise solution offering cost reduction, team collaboration, and advanced voice customization features
- [Murf Reader](https://murf.ai/murf-reader): Enterprise-grade TTS reader tool for publishers with copy-paste integration and professional narration

## Integrations

- [Integrations Hub](https://murf.ai/integrations): Connect Murf AI with LMS platforms, authoring tools, and popular content creation applications
- [Canva Integration](https://murf.ai/integrations/canva): Add professional voiceovers to Canva designs for video content creation
- [Google Slides Integration](https://murf.ai/integrations/google-slides): Add professional voice overs to Google Slides presentations using Murf AI add-on
- [PowerPoint Integration](https://murf.ai/integrations/powerpoint): Automate PowerPoint presentation narration 100x faster with Murf AI PPT plugin
- [HTML iframe Embed](https://murf.ai/integrations/iframe-embed): Embed Murf voices into websites and tools using HTML iframe for seamless integration

## Learning & Documentation

- [Conversational AI Guide](https://murf.ai/conversational-ai): Comprehensive guide to conversational AI technology, components, and deployment strategies
- [Help Center](https://help.murf.ai): Murf AI help center with FAQs, getting started guides, and API documentation
